title: Digital Railway & Condition Monitoring

canonicalTerminology.definition: Condition monitoring is the acquisition and interpretation of information about an asset's condition to support maintenance or operational decision-making.

claims.text: Digital railway condition-monitoring systems combine sensing, data acquisition, communications, analytics and human decision processes; analytics do not replace approved inspection or maintenance requirements.
claims.applicabilityNote: Level-neutral educational statement; adapt depth without changing the canonical fact.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show data flow from asset sensor to governed maintenance decision.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent alarm limits, failure thresholds or predictive-maintenance guarantees.
Do not let analytics outputs override approved inspection or maintenance requirements.
